author: Good Enough
description:
WASP-127 b is home to some of the fastest planetary winds ever measured. This extreme exoplanet has supersonic winds racing around its atmosphere at incredible speeds, making it one of the most violent and unusual worlds astronomers have discovered.

If a human somehow entered the atmosphere of WASP-127 b, the enormous wind speeds, intense heat, and crushing atmospheric conditions would make survival impossible without extraordinary protection. This Short explores WASP-127 b, supersonic winds, extreme exoplanets, alien weather, and what a person would experience on one of the windiest planets ever discovered.
